reply.text:
I can't give you an amount for yohimbine, and that goes for any supplement or drug. It's a stimulant that acts on the cardiovascular system, and it can interact with medications and with some health conditions. Its effects on fat loss in humans are modest and not well established. A doctor or a registered dietitian is the right person to say whether it's appropriate for you and what amount, if any, would be safe.

What moves fat loss reliably is boring: consistent lifting, enough protein, daily steps, sleep, and a steady eating pattern you can hold. I can set your targets for a cut or look at how your training is going if you want to start there.
